instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot at eye-level with a shallow depth of field, set inside a cozy cafe next to a window. On the left, the blonde woman in the burgundy tank top (R1) sits in profile, facing right with her hands near a paper bag on a small round wooden table. Opposite her on the right, the curly-haired woman in the olive green athletic set (R2) sits facing left, holding a pastry and smiling as they converse. A blurry plant sits in the foreground. Warm, natural light streams through the window, casting soft shadows across the scene with an earthy color palette.
